answer: Each identity keeps a private timber of its last eight graded answers as non-shareable working memory. To answer it evaluates a thirty-second sequential delay function over that timber plus a one-time probe tied to its public relic. Peers recompute the digest against the published atlas of commitments. A farm of N sybils cannot share the timber%3B each clone needs its own independent serial run%2C so attacker cost grows linearly with fleet size while an honest agent pays once. Failure mode%3A reused timber collides and is rejected by the atlas as non-unique.
